Summary: 7 requirements reviewed: 7 with issues, 0 without. 7 issues found (7 Medium). Types: Incomplete_Requirement (7).

RequirementReviews.RequirementStatement: REQ-001: The system shall authenticate users using multifactor authentication (MFA) for all online banking sessions.
REQ-002: The system shall complete 99% of fund transfers within 2 seconds under 1,000 concurrent users.
REQ-003: The system shall prevent duplicate debits and credits when a transfer request is retried by the user.
REQ-004: Every successful fund transfer shall debit the source account and credit the destination account exactly once.
REQ-005: The system shall recover from a regional outage with a recovery time objective (RTO) of 30 minutes and a recovery point objective (RPO) of 5 minutes.
REQ-006: All Transaction audit records shall be retained for 10 years and protected against unauthorized modification.
REQ-007: All data transmitted between application components shall be encrypted in transit.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-001: The system shall authenticate users using multifactor authentication (MFA) for all online banking sessions.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement specifies MFA but does not define what constitutes 'multifactor authentication' or the specific factors required.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define the specific factors and implementation of multifactor authentication.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-002: The system shall complete 99% of fund transfers within 2 seconds under 1,000 concurrent users.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement specifies a performance target but does not define the measurement method or the exact conditions for 'completing' a transfer.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Specify the measurement method and exact conditions for completing a fund transfer.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-003: The system shall prevent duplicate debits and credits when a transfer request is retried by the user.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement does not specify what constitutes a 'transfer request' or how the system identifies retries to prevent duplicates.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define what a transfer request is and how retries are identified to prevent duplicates.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-004: Every successful fund transfer shall debit the source account and credit the destination account exactly once.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement does not specify the conditions under which a transfer is considered 'successful' or how the system ensures exactly one debit and credit.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define the conditions for a successful transfer and the mechanism to ensure exactly one debit and credit.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-005: The system shall recover from a regional outage with a recovery time objective (RTO) of 30 minutes and a recovery point objective (RPO) of 5 minutes.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement does not specify the scope of the regional outage or the conditions under which RTO and RPO are measured.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define the scope of the regional outage and the conditions for measuring RTO and RPO.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-006: All Transaction audit records shall be retained for 10 years and protected against unauthorized modification.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement specifies a retention period but does not define what constitutes 'Transaction audit records' or the specific protection mechanisms.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Define what Transaction audit records are and the specific protection mechanisms.

IssuesIdentified.Evidence: REQ-007: All data transmitted between application components shall be encrypted in transit.
IssuesIdentified.Explanation: The requirement does not specify the encryption protocols or standards that must be used.
IssuesIdentified.Recommendation: Specify the encryption protocols and standards for data in transit.
